digest.component_or_area: Code review contribution flow and documentation
propositions: Gerrit changes with known unresolved issues must be marked as work-in-progress to prevent unintended submission when review votes are green but findings remain unfold
Authors must use push-time syntax (refs/for/main%wip) or existing-change REST endpoint (POST /a/changes/<n>/wip) to enforce holds, since ticket comments and session logs are invisible to submitters

The contribution flow documentation must surface the WIP hold rule on all three surfaces authors and agents read: CONTRIBUTING.md (authoritative), passing-code-review.md guide (on-ramp), and AGENTS.md (agent workflow)
Ticket holds recorded in comments or logs are advisory and unenforceable; only Gerrit WIP state structurally prevents submission across all submitter types (humans, bots, sessions)
The packaged code-review guide must carry the WIP rule reachable through registry mapping (rebar explain review), not just file paths, to ensure the rule survives guide packaging changes
